words.en: An object, fact, affair, circumstance, or concept considered as being a separate entity.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.ex_cn: 我认为这是个好主意。
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.tr: v. 想；思考；“think”的过去式和过去分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I thought about the problem all day.
words.ex_cn: 我整天都在想这个问题。
words.en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind.

words.tr:
adj. 第三的；
n. 三分之一；第三；
adv. 第三；
words.ex: He finished in third place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第三名。
words.en: Coming after the second and just before the fourth in position.

words.ex: He is thirsty after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后口渴了。
words.en: If you are thirsty, you feel a need to drink something.

words.ex: There are thirteen apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十三个苹果。
words.en: The number 13, which is one more than twelve and one less than fourteen.

words.ex: He has thirty books in his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他的包里有三十本书。
words.en: The number 30.

words.tr:
pron. 这个；
adj. 这；
adv. 这样；这个；这么；
words.ex: This is my book.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的书。
words.en: You use 'this' to refer to a person or thing that is near you, especially when you touch them or point to them.

words.tr: pron. 那些；“that”的复数； adj. 那些的；
words.ex: Those books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 那些书在桌子上。
words.en: You use those to refer to people or things which have already been mentioned or which are already known about.

words.tr:
conj. 虽然；尽管；然而；
adv. 虽然；尽管；可是；
words.ex: Though it was raining, he went out.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use though to introduce a statement in a subordinate clause which contrasts with the statement in the main clause. You often use though to introduce a fact which you regard as less important than the fact in the main clause.

words.tr:
num. 一千；
n. 千；千个；
words.ex: There are a thousand stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有一千颗星星。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of a hundred and ten; 1,000.

words.ex: She picked up a thread from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她从布料上捡起一根线。
words.en: A thread is a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving. It can also refer to a theme or idea that connects parts of a story or discussion.

words.ex: I have three apples.
words.ex_cn: 我有三个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and two; one more than two.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.ex: He throw the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To propel something through the air with a movement of the arm and hand.

words.tr: v. 丢弃；抛；“throw”的过去分词；
words.ex: He threw away the old book and was thrown it into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把那本旧书丢进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you throw something, you send it through the air using your hand or arm.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期四有一个会议。
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.ex: He ties his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系鞋带。
words.en: To fasten or secure with or as if with a cord, rope, or strap.

words.ex: The tiger walks quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 老虎在森林里静静地行走。
words.en: A tiger is a large wild animal that has a yellow and black striped coat and is a member of the cat family.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.tr: adj. 疲倦的；厌烦的； v. “tire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt tired after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到疲倦。
words.en: If you are tired, you feel that you want to rest or sleep.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.ex: I want to go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我想去公园。
words.en: Used to indicate the direction, destination, or position of something in relation to something else.

words.tr:
adv. 在今天；当今；
n. 今天；当今；
words.ex: I will finish my homework today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天会完成我的作业。
words.en: This day, as distinct from yesterday or tomorrow.

words.ex: We work together every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天一起工作。
words.en: If people do something together, they do it with each other.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: She added a tomato to her salad.
words.ex_cn: 她往沙拉里加了一个西红柿。
words.en: A tomato is a soft, red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable.

words.tr:
n. 明天；
adv. 在明天；
words.ex: I will go to school tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天去学校。
words.en: The day after today; in the future.

words.ex: He lifted a ton of bricks yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天搬了一吨砖。
words.en: A ton is a unit of weight equal to 2,240 pounds in Britain and 2,000 pounds in the United States. It is also used informally to mean a large amount of something.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.tr:
adv. 在今晚；
n. 今晚；
words.ex: We will have dinner together tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我们今晚一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Tonight refers to the evening or night of the current day.

words.ex: The coffee is too hot to drink.
words.ex_cn: 这咖啡太热了，没法喝。
words.en: In addition; also; more than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively or extremely.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后刷了牙。
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刷牙。
words.en: The hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.ex: He brushes his teeth with a toothbrush every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用牙刷刷牙。
words.en: A toothbrush is a small brush with a long handle that you use to clean your teeth.

words.ex: He brushes his teeth with toothpaste every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用牙膏刷牙。
words.en: A thick, soft, moist substance used on a toothbrush for cleaning the teeth.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 总费用是50美元。
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.ex: He walked toward the door.
words.ex_cn: 他朝门走去。
words.en: In the direction of; in relation to; near to; for the purpose of.

words.ex: He walked towards the park.
words.ex_cn: 他朝公园走去。
words.en: In the direction of; with a tendency to; in relation to; for the purpose of.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.ex: He lives in a small town near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小镇上。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.ex: The child plays with a toy car.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在玩一辆玩具汽车。
words.en: A toy is an object for children to play with.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: He can translate words into pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他能把词语转化为图画。
words.en: To translate means to change written or spoken words from one language into another, or to explain something in a way that is easier to understand.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

chapters.name: 第一部分 考纲词汇1600 第21回合

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树长在房子旁边。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是真实的。
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.ex: I will try to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我将尝试每天早上跑步。
words.en: To make an attempt or effort to do something.

words.ex: He wears a red t-shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一件红色T恤。
words.en: A T-shirt is a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, typically made of cotton.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期二有一个会议。
words.en: Tuesday is the day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.ex: He watches tv every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.tr: n. 电视节目；电视行业；电视机；
words.ex: He watches television every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.ex: He finished in twelfth place in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第十二名。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number twelve in a series.

words.ex: There are twelve apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十二个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of three and four; one more than eleven, or two less than fourteen; 12.

words.ex: He was born on the twentieth of May.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于五月二十日。
words.en: The twentieth item in a series is the one that you count as number twenty.

words.ex: He has twenty apples in his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他的包里有二十个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of two and ten; ten less than thirty; 20.

words.ex: I visited my grandparents twice last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年我去了祖父母家两次。
words.en: Two times; on two occasions.

words.ex: I have two apples.
words.ex_cn: 我有两个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and one; one less than three.

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.ex: He is from the UK.
words.ex_cn: 他来自英国。
words.en: The United Kingdom, a sovereign state in northwestern Europe.

words.ex: He opened his umbrella when it started to rain.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他打开了伞。
words.en: An umbrella is a device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sunlight.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.ex: The cat is under the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: In or to a position below or beneath something.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: v. 明白；懂得；“understand”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 懂得的；
words.ex: I understood the lesson quickly.
words.ex_cn: 我很快明白了这堂课的内容。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of understand, which means to perceive the intended meaning of (words, a language, or a speaker).

words.ex: This box weighs one unit.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子重一单位。
words.en: A unit is a single thing or person that is part of something larger.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.tr:
prep. 到…时；直到…为止；
conj. 到…时；直到…为止；
words.ex: He waited until the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到公交车来。
words.en: Up to the time of; before (a specified time).

words.ex: The balloon went up into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 气球升上了天空。
words.en: toward a higher place or position

words.ex: He will call you upon his arrival.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给你打电话。
words.en: On or onto a surface or position above or on top of something.

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼去睡觉了。
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一次测验。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.tr: v. 使用；利用；“use”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 习惯的；使用过的；二手的；
words.ex: He used a pen to write the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支笔写了这封信。
words.en: Previously owned by someone else; second-hand.

words.ex: This tool is useful for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对解决数学问题很有用。
words.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

words.tr: adj. 通常的；寻常的；惯常的；
words.ex: He takes the usual bus to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通常坐这路公交车去上班。
words.en: If something is usual, it happens most often or was most often the case in the past.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 她通常走路去学校。
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.tr:
abbr. 影碟光盘；“Versatile Compact Disk”的缩写
abbr. 视频高密光盘；“Video Compact Disc”的缩写
words.ex: He bought a VCD of the movie last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一张这部电影的VCD。
words.en: A VCD (Video CD) is a home video format and the first format for distributing films on standard 120 mm optical discs. It was widely used in the 1990s and early 2000s.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.tr:
adv. 非常；很；
adj. 恰好是；正是；
words.ex: He is very happy today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天非常开心。
words.en: Used to emphasize the degree or extent of something.

words.ex: The team celebrated their victory after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球队庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A victory is a success in a struggle, war, or competition.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.ex: The visitor took photos of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位参观者拍了博物馆的照片。
words.en: A visitor is someone who is visiting a person or place.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打排球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.ex: He wakes up at six every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点醒来。
words.en: To wake means to stop sleeping or to cause someone to stop sleeping. It can also refer to the trail left by a moving ship.

words.ex: He woke up early to catch the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他早早醒来去看日出。
words.en: Aware of and actively attentive to important societal facts and issues (especially issues of racial and social justice).

words.tr: v. 唤醒；觉醒；“wake”的过去分词；
words.ex: The loud noise woken the baby.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音把婴儿唤醒了。
words.en: Woken is the past participle of wake, meaning to stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping.

words.tr:
v. 行走；
n. 步行；
words.ex: I walk to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天步行去学校。
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace; to go on foot for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙涂成蓝色。
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.ex: I want a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.ex: The war ended last year.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争去年结束了。
words.en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖的；
v. （使）变暖；
words.ex: The sun gives us warm light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳给我们温暖的光。
words.en: Having or giving out a moderate degree of heat, as perceived by the senses.

words.tr: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意；
words.ex: The teacher warned the students not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要迟到。
words.en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

words.ex: I wash my hands before eating.
words.ex_cn: 我吃饭前洗手。
words.en: To clean something using water and usually soap.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.ex: He eats a watermelon every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都吃西瓜。
words.en: A watermelon is a large, round fruit with green skin, pink flesh, and black seeds.

words.tr: n. 方式；道路；方向；路线；方法；
words.ex: He found a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方式。
words.en: A way is a method, style, or manner of doing something, or a route or path that you take to get from one place to another.

words.ex: We are eating lunch now.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在吃午饭。
words.en: We is the first person plural pronoun used by a speaker or writer to refer to themselves and one or more other people considered together.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.tr:
v. 穿；戴；
n. 磨损；衣着；
words.ex: He wears a blue shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都穿一件蓝色衬衫。
words.en: If you wear something such as clothes, shoes, or jewellery, you have them on your body or on part of your body.

words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: The past tense of wear, meaning to have clothing, jewelry, etc., on your body.

words.tr: v. 穿；戴；“wear”的过去分词； adj. 穿坏的；用旧的；
words.ex: He wore a blue shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件蓝色衬衫去上班。
words.en: If something is worn, it has been used a lot and shows signs of use.

chapters.name: 第一部分 考纲词汇1600 第22回合

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期三有一个会议。
words.en: Wednesday is the day of the week that comes after Tuesday and before Thursday.

words.ex: I will see you next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周见你。
words.en: A week is a period of seven days.

words.tr: n. 工作日（周一至周五中的任何一天）
words.ex: He goes to work every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个工作日都去上班。
words.en: A weekday is any of the days from Monday to Friday, when most people go to work or school.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我这周末去看你。
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.ex: The doctor will weigh the baby at the clinic.
words.ex_cn: 医生将在诊所称量婴儿的体重。
words.en: To weigh something means to measure how heavy it is, usually by using scales. It can also mean to consider something carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.ex_cn: 欢迎来到我们的学校！
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr: adj. 更好的；更优秀的；“good”的比较级； adv. 更好地；“well”的比较级； v. 胜过；使更佳；
words.ex: This shirt is better than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更好。
words.en: If something is better, it is of a higher standard, quality, or level than something else, or than it was before.

words.tr:
adj. 最好的；
adv. 最好地；
n. 最佳物；佼佼者；最高水平；
words.ex: He is the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Of the most excellent, effective, or desirable type or quality.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是西街1071号。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.ex: The ground is wet after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是湿的。
words.en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

words.ex: The whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the sea.

words.ex: What is your name?
words.ex_cn: 你叫什么名字？
words.en: You use 'what' in questions when you ask for specific information about something that you do not know.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.ex: Farmers grow wheat in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植小麦。
words.en: Wheat is a cereal plant that is grown in temperate countries and is the most important kind grown for food.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.tr:
conj. 在…的时候；
adv. 什么时候；
words.ex: I eat breakfast when I wake up.
words.ex_cn: 我醒来的时候吃早餐。
words.en: You use when to ask about the time that something happened or will happen.

words.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
words.ex_cn: 无论何时你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
words.en: at any or every time that

words.ex: Where is the book?
words.ex_cn: 书在哪里？
words.en: You use where to ask questions about the place or position of someone or something, or to indicate the place or position of someone or something.

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
words.en: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

words.tr:
pron. 哪个；
adj. 哪个的；
words.ex: Which book do you want to read?
words.ex_cn: 你想读哪本书？
words.en: You use which in questions when there are two or more possible answers or alternatives.

words.tr:
conj. 当…的时候；尽管；然而；
n. 一段时间；一会儿；
words.ex: I read a book while I waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我等公交车的时候读了一本书。
words.en: While is used to introduce a clause in which you mention something that happens at the same time as something else, or to introduce a clause that contrasts with something else that you have mentioned.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.ex_cn: 白色的猫坐在窗台上。
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.ex: Who is that girl?
words.ex_cn: 那个女孩是谁？
words.en: You use who in questions to ask about the name, identity, or function of one or more people.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: Whom did you invite to the party?
words.ex_cn: 你邀请了谁来参加派对？
words.en: You use whom in questions when you ask about the name or identity of a person or group of people.

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.ex: Why did you come late?
words.ex_cn: 你为什么来晚了？
words.en: You use why in questions when you ask about the reasons for something.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.ex: He bought a flower for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妻子买了一朵花。
words.en: A wife is a married woman considered in relation to her husband.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.tr:
v. 赢；获得；
n. 胜利；赢得；
words.ex: I want to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 我想赢这场比赛。
words.en: to achieve first position and/or get a prize in a competition, election, fight, etc.

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.ex_cn: 我有一个苹果。
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.ex: It is a windy day today.
words.ex_cn: 今天是多风的一天。
words.en: If it is windy, the wind is blowing a lot.

words.ex: He drinks wine with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃饭时喝葡萄酒。
words.en: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.ex: The birds fly south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，鸟儿飞向南方。
words.en: Winter is the season between autumn and spring. In the winter, the weather is usually cold.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.tr:
v. 祝愿；希望；
n. 祝福；愿望；
words.ex: I wish you a happy birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我祝愿你生日快乐。
words.en: If you wish to do something or you wish to have it done for you, you want to do it or have it done.

words.ex: She went to the park with her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和她的朋友去了公园。
words.en: used to indicate accompaniment, association, or relationship

words.ex: He cannot swim without water.
words.ex_cn: 没有水，他不会游泳。
words.en: If you do something without something else, you do not have that thing with you or you do not use that thing.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: The woman is walking her dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个女人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A woman is an adult female human being.

words.tr:
v. 想知道；
n. 惊奇；奇迹；
words.ex: I wonder why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。
words.en: To feel curiosity or doubt about something; a feeling of surprise mingled with admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.ex: The concert was wonderful.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太精彩了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as wonderful, you think they are extremely good.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.tr:
v. 担心；担忧；
n. 担心；忧虑；
words.ex: She worries about her son every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天为她的儿子担心。
words.en: If you worry, you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.tr:
adj. 值得的；有…价值；
n. 价值；
words.ex: This book is worth reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something is worth a particular amount of money, it can be sold for that amount or is considered to have that value.

words.tr: n. 伤口；创伤； v. “wind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He cleaned the wound with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水清洗了伤口。
words.en: A wound is damage to part of your body, especially a cut or a hole in your flesh, which is caused by a gun, knife, or other weapon.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写一封信。
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.tr: v. 写作；“write”的过去式；书写；写信；
words.ex: He wrote a letter to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友写了一封信。
words.en: The past tense of write, which means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.tr: v. “write”的过去分词；写作；书写； adj. 书面的；
words.ex: The letter was written by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这封信是手写的。
words.en: Something that is written has been recorded in writing rather than spoken.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He is a writer who loves to write stories.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位喜欢写故事的作家。
words.en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job or regular occupation.

words.ex: The doctor used an x-ray to check his bone.
words.ex_cn: 医生用X光检查了他的骨头。
words.en: An X-ray is a type of radiation that can pass through most solid materials. X-rays are used in medicine to make images of the inside of the body.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.ex: He was born in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于2000年。
words.en: A year is a period of time that is approximately equal to the time it takes for the Earth to make one complete orbit around the Sun.

words.tr:
adj. 黄色的；
n. 黄色；
words.ex: The banana is yellow.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉是黄色的。
words.en: Yellow is the color of lemons, butter, or the middle part of an egg. It is one of the three primary colors.

words.ex: He asked if I wanted coffee, and I said yes.
words.ex_cn: 他问我是否想要咖啡，我说是。
words.en: Used to give an affirmative response or to agree with a positive statement.

words.tr:
adv. 昨天；
n. 昨天；
words.ex: I saw her yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天见到她了。
words.en: The day before today.

words.tr:
adv. 还；然而；
conj. 然而；
words.ex: He hasn't finished his homework yet.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: You use yet in negative statements to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, although it probably will happen.

words.ex: You are my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 你是我最好的朋友。
words.en: Used to refer to the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: Is this your book?
words.ex_cn: 这是你的书吗？
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: This book is yours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是你的。
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己。
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.ex: You should clean your room yourselves.
words.ex_cn: 你们应该自己打扫房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when this is the same as the subject of the clause and the subject is you.

words.ex: The zebra runs fast in the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 斑马在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: A zebra is an African wild horse with black-and-white stripes.

words.ex: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零。
words.en: Zero is the number 0; nothing.

words.ex: We visited the zoo to see the lions.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园看狮子。
words.en: A place where live animals are kept so that people can go to look at them.

chapters.name: 第二部分 考纲外，教材内词汇400 第23回合

words.ex: He uses an abacus to count numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用算盘来数数。
words.en: An abacus is a frame with rows of wires or grooves along which beads are slid, used for calculating.

words.ex: The teacher said the answer is acceptable.
words.ex_cn: 老师说这个答案是可以接受的。
words.en: Something that is acceptable is satisfactory or good enough to be allowed or approved of.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: The actress sings in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位女演员在电影中唱歌。
words.en: An actress is a woman whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.tr: adv. 事实上；实际上；竟然；
words.ex: I thought he was late, but actually he was on time.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上他准时到了。
words.en: You use actually to indicate that a situation exists or happened, or to emphasize that it is true.

words.ex: The temple was built in AD 300.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙建于公元300年。
words.en: An ad is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.ex: I admire my teacher for her patience.
words.ex_cn: 我钦佩我的老师有耐心。
words.en: If you admire someone or something, you like and respect them very much.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.ex: He went on an adventure in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他去丛林里冒险。
words.en: An adventure is an exciting experience or undertaking that is typically bold, sometimes risky.

words.ex: The school is handling the affair carefully.
words.ex_cn: 学校正在小心处理这件事。
words.en: An affair is a situation or subject that is being dealt with or considered; it can also refer to a secret sexual relationship between two people.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: He finished the work ahead of time.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了工作。
words.en: If someone is ahead in a competition or comparison, they are winning or doing better than the other people involved.

words.tr:
n. 帮助；援助；
v. 帮助；协助；
words.ex: The charity provided aid to the flood victims.
words.ex_cn: 慈善机构向洪水受害者提供了帮助。
words.en: To aid someone means to help or assist them. Aid can also refer to the help or support given.

words.tr:
n. 目标；目的；
v. 瞄准；以其为目标；
words.ex: His aim is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: An aim is a goal or purpose that you are trying to achieve. It can also refer to the act of directing a weapon or other object towards a target.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: Children find amusement in playing games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩游戏时感到快乐。
words.en: Amusement is the feeling that you have when you think that something is funny or entertaining.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.ex: The teacher will announce the results tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将宣布结果。
words.en: To announce something means to make it known publicly or officially.

words.ex: The loud music annoys me.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我烦恼。
words.en: If someone or something annoys you, it makes you fairly angry and impatient.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.ex: He apologizes for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而道歉。
words.en: To express regret for something that one has done wrong.

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.tr: v. 指出；表明；争论；争辩；
words.ex: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他指出这个计划太昂贵了。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.ex: I will arrange a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我将为明天安排一次会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.ex: He felt ashamed for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对妈妈撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: If someone is ashamed, they feel embarrassed or guilty because of something they have done or because of their appearance.

words.ex: He joined a local book association.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了一个本地的图书协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.tr:
n. 企图；试图；
v. 企图；试图；
words.ex: His attempt to cheat on the test failed.
words.ex_cn: 他企图在考试中作弊，但失败了。
words.en: To make an effort to achieve or complete something, especially something difficult.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.ex: The bright flowers attract bees.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr:
n. 奖品；裁定；
v. 授予；
words.ex: He received an award for best student.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳学生奖。
words.en: An award is a prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.tr:
adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；
adv. 非常；极其；
words.ex: The weather today is awful.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you say that something is awful, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant, shocking, or bad.

words.tr: abbr. 公元前；“before Christ”的缩写
words.ex: The pyramid was built in 2500 b.c.
words.ex_cn: 这座金字塔建于公元前2500年。
words.en: Before Christ; used to indicate that a date is before the Christian era.

words.ex: The pyramid was built before Christ.
words.ex_cn: 这座金字塔建于公元前。
words.en: Before Christ (BC) is a designation used to number years in the Julian and Gregorian calendars before the traditional year of the birth of Jesus Christ.

words.ex: He has a backache after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后背疼。
words.en: A backache is a pain in your back.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.ex: He played badly in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中表现得很差。
words.en: If something is done badly or goes badly, it is not successful or effective.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: The barber cuts hair every day.
words.ex_cn: 理发师每天剪头发。
words.en: A barber is a person whose job is cutting men's hair and sometimes shaving their beards.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.tr: n. 洗澡；游泳；沐浴； v. 沐浴；用水洗；沉浸；“bathe”的现在分词；“bath”的现在分词；
words.ex: He enjoys bathing every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天早上洗澡。
words.en: The act of washing oneself or swimming in water.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.tr:
n. 战斗；
v. 战斗；
words.ex: The soldiers fought in a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们进行了一场漫长的战斗。
words.en: A battle is a violent fight between groups of people, especially one between military forces during a war.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.tr: adj. 出生的；天生的； v. 生（孩子）；“bear”的过去分词；
words.ex: He is a born teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是个天生的老师。
words.en: When a baby is born, it comes out of its mother's body at the beginning of its life.

words.ex: He grew a thick beard last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天他留了一脸浓密的胡须。
words.en: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

words.tr: n. 美；美的事物；美丽；美人；
words.ex: The beauty of the sunset amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 日落的美让所有人都惊叹。
words.en: Beauty is the quality of being pleasing, especially to look at, or someone or something that gives great pleasure, especially when you look at it.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.ex: He rubbed his belly after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后揉了揉腹部。
words.en: The belly is the front part of a person's or animal's body between the chest and the legs.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.ex: He sat on the bench in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在公园的长凳上。
words.en: A bench is a long seat for several people, typically made of wood or metal.

words.tr:
v. 敢说；
n. 打赌；赌注；
words.ex: I bet you didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 我敢说你不知道那件事。
words.en: If you bet on the result of a horse race, football game, or other event, you give someone a sum of money which they give you back with extra money if the result is what you predicted, or which they keep if it is not.

words.ex: He drinks a cold beverage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝一杯冷饮。
words.en: A drink, especially one other than water; a liquid for drinking.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.ex: The water begins to boil at 100 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 水在100度时开始沸腾。
words.en: When a liquid boils or when you boil it, it reaches the temperature at which it starts to turn into a gas.

words.ex: The bookcase is full of storybooks.
words.ex_cn: 书架上放满了故事书。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He bought a novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A bookstore is a shop where books are sold.

words.ex: Don't bother to clean the room, I'll do it later.
words.ex_cn: 别麻烦去打扫房间了，我稍后会做。
words.en: To bother someone means to cause them trouble or to annoy them.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.tr: n. 断路器；破碎机；碎浪
words.ex: The breaker turned off when the power overloaded.
words.ex_cn: 当电力过载时，断路器跳闸了。
words.en: A breaker is a device that stops the flow of electricity in a circuit when the current becomes too strong, or a wave that breaks into foam on the shore.

words.ex: The sun brightens the room in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早上使房间变亮。
words.en: To make something lighter or more colorful, or to make someone feel happier or more hopeful.

words.ex: The sun shone brightly through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光明亮地照进窗户。
words.en: In a manner that is full of light or shining strongly; in a way that is cheerful and lively.

words.ex: The bird lives in a small cage.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟住在一个小笼子里。
words.en: A cage is a structure of wire or metal bars in which birds or animals are kept.

words.ex: The radio station hosts a popular call-in show every evening.
words.ex_cn: 这家广播电台每晚都举办一个受欢迎的电话交谈节目。
words.en: A call-in is a radio or television program in which people telephone the studio to give their opinions or ask questions.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很平静。
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.tr: v. 闲聊；闲谈； n. 聊天( chat的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They are chatting about their weekend plans.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在闲聊关于周末的计划。
words.en: The act of talking in an informal and friendly way.

words.ex: He is chewing gum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大声地嚼口香糖。
words.en: To chew means to bite and grind food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: The lawyer helped her client with the contract.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助她的客户处理合同。
words.en: A client is a person or organization receiving services or advice from a professional or company.

words.ex: I watched a clip of the movie on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我在YouTube上看了这部电影的一个片段。
words.en: A clip is a small device, usually made of metal or plastic, that is specially shaped for holding things together. As a verb, to clip means to cut something, especially to make it shorter or neater.

words.ex: The clown made the children laugh.
words.ex_cn: 小丑让孩子们笑了。
words.en: A clown is a performer, typically in a circus, who wears a traditional costume and exaggerated makeup, and entertains by performing comedic acts.

chapters.name: 第二部分 考纲外，教材内词汇400 第24回合

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.ex: He is a collector of old coins.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位古钱币收藏家。
words.en: A collector is a person who collects things of a particular type as a hobby or for investment.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.tr:
n. 连环漫画；
adj. 滑稽的；
words.ex: He reads a comic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读一本连环漫画。
words.en: A comic is someone who entertains people by making them laugh, especially a professional comedian.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: The instructions confuse me.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明让我感到困惑。
words.en: If you confuse two things, you mix them up in your mind so that you think one is the other.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: adj. 令人信服的；有说服力的； v. 说服；“convince”的现在分词；
words.ex: His argument was convincing.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点令人信服。
words.en: A convincing argument, evidence, or person is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.ex: Apples are countable things.
words.ex_cn: 苹果是可数的东西。
words.en: Capable of being counted; denumerable.

words.ex: My co-worker helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A person with whom one works, typically in a professional context.

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: He is the creator of that popular game.
words.ex_cn: 他是那个流行游戏的创作者。
words.en: A creator is someone who brings something into existence, especially someone who invents or designs something new.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.ex: She has curly hair.
words.ex_cn: 她有一头卷发。
words.en: Having curls or a curved shape.

words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日期间点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

words.ex: The dancer moved gracefully on stage.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者在舞台上优雅地舞动。
words.en: A dancer is someone who dances or whose job is dancing.

words.ex: We work during the daytime and rest at night.
words.ex_cn: 我们在白天工作，晚上休息。
words.en: The period of the day when there is natural light, from sunrise to sunset.

words.ex: The job was a dead-end, offering no room for advancement.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作没有出路，没有晋升空间。
words.en: A dead-end is a situation, plan, or course of action that leads nowhere or is unlikely to lead to success.

words.tr: adv. 深深地；深刻地；非常；
words.ex: She was deeply moved by the story.
words.ex_cn: 她被这个故事深深打动了。
words.en: To a great depth; profoundly.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.ex: I disagree with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意你的观点。
words.en: If you disagree with someone or disagree with what they say, you do not accept that what they say is true or you do not accept that it is the correct thing to do.

words.ex: He is dishonest when he lies about his homework.
words.ex_cn: 当他谎报作业时，他是不诚实的。
words.en: If you say that someone is dishonest, you mean that they are not honest and you cannot trust them.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.ex: The boy has an earache after swimming.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩游泳后耳朵疼。
words.en: An earache is a pain in the inner part of your ear.

words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

words.ex: He can solve the problem easily.
words.ex_cn: 他很容易就能解决这个问题。
words.en: Without difficulty or effort.

words.ex: He is an easygoing man who likes to smile.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个随和的人，喜欢微笑。
words.en: Someone who is easygoing is relaxed and not easily upset or worried.

words.ex: The editor corrected the grammar in the article.
words.ex_cn: 编辑纠正了这篇文章的语法。
words.en: An editor is a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in it.

words.ex: They want to educate their children well.
words.ex_cn: 他们想好好教育自己的孩子。
words.en: To educate someone means to teach them over a period of time at a school, college, or university.

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.tr: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的； v. “embarrass”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt embarrassed when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在大家面前绊倒时感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you are embarrassed, you feel shy or ashamed because of something that you have done or that has happened to you.

words.ex: The new tool enables him to finish work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使他能够更快地完成工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.tr: n. 结束；结局； v. 结束；“end”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ending of the movie was surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的结束令人惊讶。
words.en: The final part of something, especially a story, movie, or play.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.ex: Please ensure the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: He showed great enthusiasm for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习英语表现出极大的热情。
words.en: Enthusiasm is a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something and a desire to become involved in it.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: He put the letter in an envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把信装进了一个信封。
words.en: An envelope is a flat, usually rectangular or square, paper container for a letter, which you seal before you send it by post.

words.tr:
adj. 相等的；同等的；
v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If two things are equal, or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 自动扶梯；电动扶梯；
words.ex: He took the escalator to the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘自动扶梯上了二楼。
words.en: An escalator is a moving staircase that carries people between floors of a building or structure.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: His expression showed he was happy.
words.ex_cn: 他的表情显示他很快乐。
words.en: The act of making your thoughts, feelings, etc., known by speech, writing, or some other method.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.tr: adv. 非常地；极其地；极端地；
words.ex: The weather is extremely cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气非常冷。
words.en: To an extreme degree; very.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.ex: The news was false.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻是虚假的。
words.en: If something is false, it is incorrect, untrue, or mistaken.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: Warm weather favors plant growth.
words.ex_cn: 温暖的天气有利于植物生长。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favor, you like or support them.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.tr: v. 逃跑；逃离；“flee”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The cat fled when it saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫看到狗时逃跑了。
