words.en: To run away from a place or situation of danger.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.ex: He speaks fluent English.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一口流利的英语。
words.en: If someone is fluent in a particular language, they can speak it easily and correctly.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: The furry cat curled up on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 那只毛茸茸的猫蜷缩在沙发上。
words.en: Covered with or resembling fur.

words.tr:
v. 获得；增加；
n. 增益；获得；
words.ex: He gained a new skill last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月获得了一项新技能。
words.en: To gain means to obtain something that is useful, that gives you an advantage, or that is in some way positive, especially over a period of time.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: The children threw garbage on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔在地上。
words.en: Waste material; unwanted or undesired material.

words.ex: People gather in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人们在广场上聚集庆祝节日。
words.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

words.tr:
n. 凝视；注视；
v. 凝视；注视；
words.ex: His gaze fixed on the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他的凝视固定在日落上。
words.en: If you gaze at someone or something, you look steadily at them for a long time, for example because you find them attractive or interesting, or because you are thinking about something else.

words.ex: He gave a generous donation to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他慷慨地捐钱给穷人。
words.en: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

chapters.name: 第二部分 考纲外，教材内词汇400 第25回合

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.ex: He is talking to his girlfriend on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和女朋友打电话。
words.en: A girlfriend is a woman or girl with whom someone is having a romantic or sexual relationship.

words.ex: The Earth is a globe.
words.ex_cn: 地球是一个球体。
words.en: The globe is the world; especially used to refer to the Earth as a planet.

words.ex: The goalkeeper stopped the ball with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 守门员用手挡住了球。
words.en: A goalkeeper is the player in a sports team whose job is to stop the ball from entering the goal.

words.ex: He feeds his goldfish every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喂他的金鱼。
words.en: A goldfish is a small orange or golden-colored fish that is often kept as a pet in aquariums or ponds.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.ex: He gradually learned to ride a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渐渐学会了骑自行车。
words.en: If something changes or is done gradually, it changes or is done in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: My family came to my graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人来参加我的毕业典礼。
words.en: Graduation is the successful completion of a course of study at a university, college, or school, often marked by a ceremony.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.ex: My granddad walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Your granddad is the father of your father or mother.

words.tr:
n. 灰色；
adj. 灰色的；暗淡的；
words.ex: The sky turned gray before the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨前，天空变成了灰色。
words.en: Gray is an intermediate color between black and white, often associated with gloom or dullness.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.ex: He bought a guidebook for his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他为去巴黎旅行买了一本旅游指南。
words.en: A guidebook is a book that gives tourists information about a town, area, or country.

words.ex: That guy is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 那个家伙正在等公交车。
words.en: A guy is a man or boy. You can refer to a group of people, especially men or boys, as guys.

words.ex: He changed his hairstyle last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周换了发型。
words.en: A hairstyle is the way in which someone's hair is cut and arranged.

words.ex: The dog has a hairy back.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的背部有浓密的毛。
words.en: Having a lot of hair, especially on the body; covered with hair.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.tr: adj. 勤勉的；努力工作的
words.ex: He is hard-working and always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很勤奋，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is hard-working always puts a lot of effort and care into their work.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.tr:
n. 收获；收成；
v. 收获；收割；
words.ex: The farmers celebrated the harvest in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在秋天庆祝收获。
words.en: The harvest is the process of gathering mature crops from the fields. It is a crucial activity in agriculture that marks the end of the growing season.

words.ex: The wound will heal in a few days.
words.ex_cn: 伤口几天后就会愈合。
words.en: To make or become healthy or whole again; to cure or recover from an injury or illness.

words.ex: The homeless man slept on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 那个无家可归的人睡在长椅上。
words.en: If someone is homeless, they have no permanent place to live.

words.ex: She put honey on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上涂了蜂蜜。
words.en: Honey is a sweet, sticky, yellowish-brown fluid made by bees and other insects from nectar collected from flowers.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.tr: n. 女主人；女房东；女招待；女主持人；
words.ex: The hostess welcomed us with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 女主人微笑着欢迎我们。
words.en: A woman who receives or entertains guests in a social or official capacity; a woman who is in charge of a particular event or place and who welcomes and looks after the people who attend.

words.ex: It is illegal to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 无证驾驶是非法的。
words.en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: The child imitates her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If you imitate someone, you copy what they do or produce.

words.tr: adj. 不礼貌的；无礼的；粗鲁的；
words.ex: He said hello without smiling, which was impolite.
words.ex_cn: 他打招呼时没有微笑，这是不礼貌的。
words.en: If you say that someone is impolite, you mean that they are rather rude and do not have good manners.

words.tr: v. 使留下深刻印象；使铭记；
words.ex: His speech impressed everyone in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲给在场的每个人留下了深刻印象。
words.en: If someone or something impresses you, you feel great admiration for them.

words.ex: His smile left a good impression on me.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑给我留下了好印象。
words.en: An idea, feeling, or opinion about something or someone, especially one formed without conscious thought or on the basis of little evidence.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: We stayed indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们待在室内。
words.en: If you are indoors, you are inside a building.

words.ex: The book is in the bag.
words.ex_cn: 书在包里。
words.en: Used to indicate location or position within something.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.ex: The interviewer asked him about his work experience.
words.ex_cn: 采访者问他关于他的工作经验。
words.en: An interviewer is a person who asks someone questions at an interview.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: He received an invitation to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了参加派对的邀请。
words.en: An invitation is a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.ex: He felt jealousy when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到妒忌。
words.en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.ex: The kangaroo jumps high in the Australian wild.
words.ex_cn: 袋鼠在澳大利亚的野外跳得很高。
words.en: A kangaroo is a large Australian animal which moves by jumping on its back legs. Female kangaroos carry their babies in a pouch on their stomach.

words.ex: The children carried paper lanterns at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在节日上提着纸灯笼。
words.en: A lantern is a lamp in a container that has a handle for holding or hanging it, and it usually has a protective case around the flame or bulb.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.ex: The learner practices English every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位学习者每天练习英语。
words.en: A learner is someone who is learning a particular subject or skill.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.ex: The length of the table is two meters.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的长度是两米。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.ex: He shouted loudly to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他大声喊叫以引起注意。
words.en: In a way that produces or is capable of producing much noise; not quietly.

words.tr: adj. 钟爱…的；爱好…的； v. “love”的现在分词；
words.ex: She is a loving mother who always cares for her children.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位钟爱孩子的母亲，总是关心她的孩子们。
words.en: Showing or feeling love; affectionate.

words.ex: We eat lunch at lunchtime.
words.ex_cn: 我们在午餐时间吃饭。
words.en: Lunchtime is the period of the day when people have their lunch.

words.tr: adj. 奇妙的；魔术的；有魔力的；
words.ex: The magical night lit up the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 奇妙的夜晚照亮了整个村庄。
words.en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be full of magic.

words.tr:
adj. 男性的；雄性的；
n. 男性；雄性；
words.ex: The male bird has bright red feathers.
words.ex_cn: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的红色羽毛。
words.en: A male is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that cannot have babies. In humans, males are usually considered to be boys or men.

words.ex: The lake is a man-made pond.
words.ex_cn: 这个湖是一个人工池塘。
words.en: Made or caused by human beings rather than occurring naturally.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.ex: He tries to memorize the words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天试着记住这些单词。
words.en: To memorize something means to learn it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.tr:
num. 一百万；
n. 百万；百万个；
words.ex: There are a million stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有百万颗星星。
words.en: A million is the number 1,000,000.

words.ex: He became a millionaire after selling his app.
words.ex_cn: 他卖掉自己的应用后成了百万富翁。
words.en: A millionaire is a person whose wealth amounts to a million or more in currency units such as dollars, pounds, or euros.

words.tr:
adj. 零下的；负的；
n. 缺点；
prep. 减去；
words.ex: The temperature is minus ten degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 气温是零下十摄氏度。
words.en: A minus is a mathematical symbol that represents subtraction or a negative quantity.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.ex: The mobile table can be moved easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个可移动的桌子很容易搬动。
words.en: A mobile is something that can move or be moved easily.

words.ex: The old ship was a monster on the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船在海上是个庞然大物。
words.en: A monster is an imaginary creature that is very large, ugly, and frightening.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐的歌曲。
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: The naughty boy broke his mother's vase.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽皮的男孩打碎了他妈妈的花瓶。
words.en: If you say that a child is naughty, you mean that they behave badly or do not do what they are told.

words.ex: The children are noisy in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在教室里很吵。
words.en: A noisy place is full of a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: He eats a nut every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗坚果当早餐。
words.en: A nut is a fruit consisting of a hard or tough shell around an edible kernel. It is also a metal block with a threaded hole that is used with a bolt to fasten things together. Informally, it can refer to someone who is crazy or eccentric.

words.tr:
n. 官员；高级职员；
adj. 官方的；正式的；
words.ex: The official announced new rules for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员宣布了节日的新规定。
words.en: An official is a person who holds a position of authority in a government or organization, or something that is authorized or formally recognized.

words.ex: She eats olive every day with bread.
words.ex_cn: 她每天和面包一起吃橄榄。
words.en: An olive is a small oval fruit with a hard stone and bitter flesh, green when unripe and bluish black when ripe, used as food and as a source of oil.

words.tr: n. 开始；开口；空缺职位； v. 打开；“open”的现在分词； adj. 开始的；
words.ex: The opening of the meeting was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 会议的开始被推迟了。
words.en: An opening is a gap or hole in something, or the act of making or becoming open. It can also refer to the beginning of an event or period.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.tr: adj. 普通的；平常的；一般的；
words.ex: He wore an ordinary shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件普通的衬衫去学校。
words.en: Something that is ordinary is not special or different in any way.

words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: The organization helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organization is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.ex: We had an outdoor picnic last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期天我们进行了户外野餐。
words.en: relating to or done in the open air; not inside a building

words.tr:
adv. 在户外；在野外；
n. 野外；旷野；郊外；
words.ex: The children love to play outdoors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。
words.en: If something happens outdoors, it happens outside in the fresh air rather than in a building.

words.tr: adj. 外向的；即将离职的；往外去的；
words.ex: He is an outgoing boy who loves talking to new people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个外向的男孩，喜欢和新朋友聊天。
words.en: Someone who is outgoing is very friendly and likes meeting and talking to people.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: He oversleeps every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都睡过头。
words.en: To sleep longer than intended, especially so as to wake up late.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.tr: adj. 兼职的；部分时间的
words.ex: He works part-time at a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家咖啡店做兼职。
words.en: If someone is a part-time worker or has a part-time job, they work for only part of each day or week.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

chapters.name: 第三部分 常见短语300 第26回合

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: He pretends to sleep when his mom asks him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈让他打扫房间时，他假装睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.ex: He is a programmer who writes code for apps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名为应用程序编写代码的程序员。
words.en: A programmer is a person who writes computer programs as a profession or hobby.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.ex: The rocket flew into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭飞入了太空。
words.en: A rocket is a spacecraft, aircraft, or other vehicle that obtains thrust from a rocket engine.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.ex: He poured sauce on his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他把酱汁倒在意大利面上。
words.en: A sauce is a thick liquid which is served with other food.

words.tr: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的； v. “scare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was scared of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.tr: n. 海产食物（如海鱼、贝类等）；
words.ex: We ate fresh seafood at the seaside restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的餐厅吃了新鲜的海产食物。
words.en: Seafood refers to fish and shellfish from the sea that are eaten as food.

words.ex: Children play near the seashore.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海岸边玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of the sea or ocean, especially the part that is between the land and the water.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: The sun burned his skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒伤了他的皮肤。
words.en: Your skin is the natural outer covering of your body.

words.ex: He has a slight cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有点轻微的感冒。
words.en: A slight change, difference, or action is not very great or important.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.ex: The floor is slippery after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后地板很滑。
words.en: Something that is slippery is smooth, wet, or oily and is therefore difficult to walk on or to hold.

words.ex: He walks slowly to enjoy the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地走，以便欣赏日落。
words.en: If you do something slowly, you do it at a low speed.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.tr: n. 旅游鞋；运动鞋；球鞋；（帆布胶底）运动鞋( sneaker的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He wears sneakers to walk in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他穿旅游鞋去公园散步。
words.en: Sneakers are shoes that are comfortable for walking or running, with rubber soles and cloth uppers.

words.tr:
n. 喷嚏；喷嚏声
v. 打喷嚏
words.ex: He had a cold and let out a loud sneeze.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，打了一个响亮的喷嚏。
words.en: To sneeze is to suddenly expel air from the nose and mouth due to irritation in the nasal passages.

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.ex: This factory specializes in making electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂专用于制造电动汽车。
words.en: If you specialize in a particular subject or skill, you become an expert in it by focusing your studies or work on it.

words.ex: This tool is specially designed for children.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具是专门为儿童设计的。
words.en: In a special manner; particularly.

words.ex: A spider is crawling on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 一只蜘蛛正在墙上爬。
words.en: A spider is a small creature with eight legs and a body divided into two parts, which spins webs to catch insects for food.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.tr: v. 击；袭击；打；“strike”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The hammer struck the nail.
words.ex_cn: 锤子击中了钉子。
words.en: If you strike someone or something, you deliberately hit them.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: He suffered from a bad cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周患了重感冒。
words.en: To experience something unpleasant, such as injury, pain, or loss.

words.tr: v. 遭受；忍受；“suffer”的现在分词； n. 痛苦；苦难；折磨；
words.ex: He is suffering from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他正遭受一场重感冒。
words.en: Suffering is the experience of mental or physical pain.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.tr: adj. 感到惊讶的； v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；“surprise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was surprised when I saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到礼物时，我感到很惊讶。
words.en: If you are surprised, you have a feeling of surprise, because something unexpected has happened.

words.tr: adj. 令人吃惊的；出人意料的； v. “surprise”的现在分词；
words.ex: It was surprising that he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，这令人吃惊。
words.en: Causing surprise; unexpected.

words.ex: He is a talented singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有才能的歌手。
words.en: Someone who is talented has a natural ability to do something well.

words.ex: The concert was terrific!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something or someone as terrific, you are very pleased with them or very impressed by them.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.tr:
adj. 惊险的； 令人激动的
v. 激动；震颤；兴奋；“thrill”的现在分词
words.ex: The roller coaster ride was thrilling.
words.ex_cn: 过山车之旅令人激动。
words.en: If something is thrilling, it causes a sudden feeling of great excitement, enjoyment, or sometimes fear.

words.ex: He had a sore throat after singing all night.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一整晚后喉咙疼。
words.en: Your throat is the back part of your mouth, where it connects to your neck. It includes the passage that leads from your mouth to your stomach and lungs.

words.tr:
prep. 遍及；各处；自始至终；
adv. 自始至终；到处；
words.ex: She traveled throughout the country.
words.ex_cn: 她遍及全国旅行。
words.en: In every part of a place or thing; during the whole of a period of time.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr: adj. 引起疲劳的；累人的； v. “tire”的现在分词；
words.ex: The long walk was tiring.
words.ex_cn: 这次长时间的散步让人感到疲惫。
words.en: If you describe something as tiring, you mean that it makes you tired so that you want to rest or sleep.

words.tr:
n. 脚趾
v. 用脚尖触
words.ex: He touched the ball with his toe.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚趾碰了球。
words.en: One of the five digits at the end of the foot, or the similar part of a shoe or sock.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: He showed me the trick to solve this math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他给我展示了快速解决这道数学题的诀窍。
words.en: A trick is a clever or deceitful action intended to deceive or outwit someone.

words.ex: I truly appreciate your help.
words.ex_cn: 我衷心感谢你的帮助。
words.en: You use truly to emphasize that something has all the features or qualities of a particular thing, or is the case to the fullest possible extent.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.tr:
n. 曲调；调子；
v. 调整；调音；
words.ex: He hummed a happy tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着一首欢快的曲调。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. It can also refer to adjusting something so that it works or looks better.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: Long hours of work tire him.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的工作让他感到疲倦。
words.en: If something tires you or if you tire, you feel that you have used a lot of energy and you want to rest or sleep.

words.tr: adj. 使人不舒服的；不自在的；
words.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。
words.en: If you are uncomfortable, you are slightly worried or embarrassed, and not relaxed and confident.

words.ex: The town looked unfamiliar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇对他来说很陌生。
words.en: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.ex: Eating too much sugar is unhealthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃太多糖是不健康的。
words.en: If you describe something as unhealthy, you mean that it is likely to cause illness or poor health.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.tr: adj. 不平常的；不寻常的；
words.ex: It is unusual to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不平常的。
words.en: If something is unusual, it does not happen very often or you do not see it or hear it very often.

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: The village is located in a quiet valley.
words.ex_cn: 村庄坐落在一个宁静的山谷中。
words.en: A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.tr: n. 小提琴手；小提琴演奏者；
words.ex: The violinist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手在音乐会上演奏了一首优美的曲子。
words.en: A violinist is a person who plays the violin.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: He will vote for the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 他将投票支持新领袖。
words.en: If you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

words.tr: n. 气象员；天气预报员
words.ex: The weatherman says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 气象预报员说明天会下雨。
words.en: A weatherman is a man who presents the weather forecast on television or radio.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: He wiped the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布擦了桌子。
words.en: To wipe something means to clean or dry it by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or your hand.

words.tr: adj. 担忧的；焦虑的；发愁的； v. 担心；担忧；“worry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was worried about his test results.
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的考试成绩。
words.en: If you are worried, you are unhappy because you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

chapters.name: 第三部分 常见短语300 第27回合

words.ex: I am a bit tired today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天有点累。
words.en: A bit means to a small extent or degree.

words.ex: I need a bit of time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一点时间来完成我的作业。
words.en: A small amount of something.

words.ex: I have a few apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上有一些苹果。
words.en: A small number of things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 许多，大量（用于修饰可数名词复数，相当于 many）
words.ex: A good many students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 很多学生通过了考试。
words.en: A large number of; many.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的，许多的（用于修饰可数名词复数）
words.ex: A great many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 非常多的学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of; very many.

words.ex: A dog is a kind of animal.
words.ex_cn: 狗是一种动物。
words.en: a type or sort of something

words.ex: He has a little money left.
words.ex_cn: 他剩下一点钱。
words.en: A small amount of something.

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: A number of students are late for class.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生上课迟到了。
words.en: An indefinite but considerable amount or quantity of something.

words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一双鞋。
words.en: used to describe two things that are the same or similar and are meant to be used together

words.tr: phrase. 一块；一张；一片；一件
words.ex: He ate a piece of bread.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片面包。
words.en: A portion or part of something.

words.ex: The numbers add up to 100.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字加起来等于100。
words.en: If amounts add up to a particular total, they result in that total when they are put together.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.ex: We play soccer after class.
words.ex_cn: 我们课后踢足球。
words.en: After class refers to the time following a class or lesson when students are free to engage in other activities.

words.tr: phrase. 再三地；反复不止地
words.ex: He tried again and again to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地尝试解决这个问题。
words.en: Repeatedly; many times.

words.ex: He agree to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他同意帮我做作业。
words.en: To consent to do something that has been suggested by another person.

words.ex: He agrees to help his friend with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他同意帮朋友做作业。
words.en: to consent or promise to perform a particular action

words.tr: phrase. 赞同； 同意； 适合于
words.ex: I agree with you on this point.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的这个观点。
words.en: to have the same opinion as someone else; to accept a suggestion or idea

words.tr: phrase. 同意某人；适合于某人
words.ex: I agree with my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我同意我朋友的看法。
words.en: To have the same opinion as someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 各种各样的；各种类型的
words.ex: He collects all kinds of stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他收集各种各样的邮票。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate a variety of different types or kinds of something.

words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.ex: All right, let's go now.
words.ex_cn: 好吧，我们现在走吧。
words.en: If you say that something is all right, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 一切顺利；祝你好运
words.ex: All the best in your new job!
words.ex_cn: 祝你在新工作中一切顺利！
words.en: a phrase used to wish someone success or good luck in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 到达（某地），通常用于较大的地点，如城市、国家等
words.ex: They arrive in London tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天早上到达伦敦。
words.en: To reach a destination, especially at the end of a journey.

words.ex: We arrive at the station at 9 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 我们九点到达车站。
words.en: To reach a destination or to come to a decision or conclusion after consideration.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.ex: He is as tall as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他和他的兄弟一样高。
words.en: Used to compare two things or people and say that they are equal in some way.

words.ex: He will call me as soon as he arrives.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给我打电话。
words.en: At the moment that; immediately after.

words.ex: He arrived late, as usual.
words.ex_cn: 他像往常一样迟到了。
words.en: As usual means in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases.

words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.ex: He finished his homework at last.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: After a long time or delay; finally.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: He stopped talking at once.
words.ex_cn: 他立刻停止了说话。
words.en: Immediately; without delay; at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 同时；但是；在相同的时间
words.ex: He sings and dances at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边跳舞。
words.en: If two or more things exist, happen, or are true at the same time, they exist, happen, or are true together although they seem to contradict each other.

words.ex: He is fond of playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢踢足球。
words.en: To have a liking or affection for someone or something.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He is good at math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To have a natural ability or skill in a particular area.

words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学感兴趣。
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.ex: He is late for school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都上学迟到。
words.en: To arrive somewhere after the expected or usual time.

words.tr: 由……制成（表示材料，强调原材料未发生根本性变化）
words.ex: The table is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是木头做的。
words.en: If something is made of a particular material, that material was used to build it.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 液晶显示屏，液晶显示器(Liquid Crystal Display)
words.ex: He got used to waking up early for work.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯了早起上班。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone so that it/they no longer seem(s) strange or surprising.

words.ex: He is used to waking up early for work.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起上班。
words.en: To be accustomed to doing something, implying that the action is familiar or habitual.

words.ex_cn: 他逐渐习惯了早起上班。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone so that it/they no longer seem(s) strange or unusual.

words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.ex: My mom is strict with me about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈对我的作业很严格。
words.en: To demand or enforce rules and standards rigorously.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.ex: Both my sister and my brother like ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹和我弟弟都喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: You use both ... and when you are emphasizing that something is true not just of one person, thing, or situation but also of another one.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；（使）逐渐适用
words.ex: Thieves broke in through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从后门闯入。
words.en: To enter a building by force, especially in order to steal something; to interrupt a conversation or activity.

words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.ex: He sent the package by air.
words.ex_cn: 他通过空运寄出了包裹。
words.en: Using aircraft as a means of transport.

words.ex: He goes to school by bus.
words.ex_cn: 他乘公交车去学校。
words.en: Using a bus as a means of transportation.

words.ex: I go to work by train every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐火车去上班。
words.en: Using the train as a means of transportation.

words.tr: phrase. 乘船；通过船只运输
words.ex: They traveled by ship to the island.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘船去了那个岛。
words.en: Using a ship as a means of transportation.

words.tr: phrase. 白天；在白天的时候
words.ex: He works as a teacher by day.
words.ex_cn: 他白天当老师。
words.en: During the day; in the daytime.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便说说；顺便提起
words.ex: By the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 对了，我昨天看到你弟弟了。
words.en: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to the main subject of conversation

words.tr: phrase. 给…打电话；使想起；召集
words.ex: He called up his friend to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友打电话问好。
words.en: To telephone someone; to summon someone to military service; to bring something back to one's mind.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；关怀；喜欢；想要
words.ex: She cares for her sick mother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: To like or love someone or something; to look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.ex: He ran fast to catch up with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便追上他的朋友。
words.en: To reach someone or something that is ahead of you, or to make up for lost time or progress.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

words.ex: She will change into her pajamas after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后会换上睡衣。
words.en: To become something different or to make something become different.

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 回来；记起；复原；恢复；重新流行
words.ex: He promised to come back soon.
words.ex_cn: 他答应很快就会回来。
words.en: To return to a place or to a previous activity or condition.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 下来；下降；流传；病倒
words.ex: The price of apples came down last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周苹果的价格降了。
words.en: To move or travel from a higher to a lower level or position; to descend.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个小村庄。
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.ex: He comes in every morning at 8 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上8点进来。
words.en: To enter a place, especially a building or room.

words.tr: phrase. 加油；快点；拜托；来吧；开始
words.ex: Come on, you can finish this race!
words.ex_cn: 加油，你能跑完这场比赛的！
words.en: Used to encourage someone to do something or to hurry up, or to express disbelief or skepticism.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 把……比作……；与……相比较（通常用于不同类事物之间的比喻或类比）
words.ex: He compared her smile to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他把她的微笑比作太阳。
words.en: If you compare something to something else, you say that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: The bridge connects with the other side of the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接到河的另一边。
words.en: To establish a relationship or communication with someone or something.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: phrase. 日日夜夜；不分昼夜
words.ex: He worked day and night to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他日日夜夜工作以完成这个项目。
words.en: If something happens day and night, it happens all the time without stopping.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.ex: This book is different from the one I read last week.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和我上周读的那本不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality.

words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate something into parts or sections.

words.ex: He did his best in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中尽了最大努力。
words.en: To try as hard as one can to achieve something.

chapters.name: 第三部分 常见短语300 第28回合

words.tr: 短语动词. 进行打扫；做清洁工作
words.ex: She does some cleaning every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 她每个星期六都做些清洁。
words.en: To clean a space or area, typically by tidying and removing dirt.

words.ex: She will do some shopping this afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她今天下午要去购物。
words.en: To go to stores or shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: I might drop in at your house this evening.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚可能会顺便去你家。
words.en: To visit someone informally and often without notice.

words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.ex: You can either walk to school or take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 你可以走路去学校，或者坐公交车。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) given alternatives (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: They enjoy themselves at the park every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个星期天在公园里玩得很开心。
words.en: To have a good time; to experience pleasure or satisfaction in what one is doing.

words.ex: They talked face to face instead of on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他们面对面交谈，而不是打电话。
words.en: If you meet or talk to someone face to face, you meet or talk to them directly, rather than by telephone, email, or online.

words.ex: He falls asleep quickly after turning off the light.
words.ex_cn: 他关灯后很快就睡着了。
words.en: To begin to sleep.

words.ex: He fell behind in math because he missed classes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺课而数学落下了。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others; to lag behind.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 跌倒；倒塌；失败
words.ex: The boy fell down from the chair.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从椅子上摔了下来。
words.en: To fall down means to move from a higher to a lower position, typically rapidly and without control, often resulting in landing on the ground.

words.tr: 短语动词. 生病；患病
words.ex: He fell ill yesterday and stayed in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天生病了，一直待在床上。
words.en: To become sick or to start to suffer from a disease.

words.ex: He fell into the river by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心掉进了河里。
words.en: To fall into something means to be classified or divided into it, or to start to be in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: The village is far away from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄离城市很远。
words.en: At a great distance in space or time.

words.ex: The village is far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄远离城市。
words.en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

words.ex: He fills the box with books.
words.ex_cn: 他用书把箱子装满。
words.en: To make something full by putting a substance or thing into it.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: First of all, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: Before anything else; initially.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.ex: From now on, I will study every day.
words.ex_cn: 从现在开始，我会每天学习。
words.en: Starting from this moment and continuing into the future.

words.tr: phrase. 从那时起，从那以后
words.ex: He failed the test, but from then on he studied every day.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，但从那以后他每天学习。
words.en: From a particular time in the past onwards.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.ex: The store is open from nine to five.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店从九点营业到五点。
words.en: Used to indicate the range or period of time between two points.

words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.ex: The thief tried to get away from the police.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图逃脱警察。
words.en: If you get away, you succeed in leaving a place or a person's company. If you get away with something, you succeed in doing it without being caught or punished.

words.tr: phrase. 回来；取回；恢复；报复
words.ex: He will get back tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会回来。
words.en: To return to a place, condition, or activity; to recover something lost or taken away; to retaliate.

words.tr: 短语动词. 靠近；接近；变得亲密
words.ex: The cat gets close to the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近鸟。
words.en: To move or come nearer to someone or something in distance.

words.ex: The cat tries to get close to the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫试图靠近那只鸟。
words.en: To move or come near to someone or something in distance or time.

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.tr: phrase. 着手做；开始认真做
words.ex: He got down to work after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后开始认真工作。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something seriously or with determination.

words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人相处融洽；继续与某人交往
words.ex: I get on with my brother even when we argue.
words.ex_cn: 即使我们吵架，我和我哥哥还是相处得很好。
words.en: If you get on with someone, you are friendly and have a good relationship with them.

words.ex: He wants to get out of debt.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱债务。
words.en: To leave a place or situation; to avoid doing something that you do not want to do.

words.ex: He is getting ready for school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为上学做准备。
words.en: To prepare oneself for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He is ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他准备好考试了。
words.en: To be prepared or in a state of readiness for something that is expected to happen.

words.ex: We get together every weekend to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末聚在一起打篮球。
words.en: If people get together, they meet in order to spend time with each other.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点起床。
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 归还；回馈；恢复
words.ex: He will give back the book tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会把书还回去。
words.en: If you give something back, you return it to the person who gave it to you or to the person who owns it.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；外出；（症状）消失
words.ex: Go away, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 走开，我需要休息。
words.en: To leave a place or to stop being present in a situation.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.ex: He goes fishing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末去钓鱼。
words.en: To go fishing means to spend time trying to catch fish, typically as a hobby or for relaxation.

words.ex: She goes shopping every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 她每个星期六去购物。
words.en: To visit shops to buy goods.

words.ex: They go skating every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末去滑冰。
words.en: To engage in the activity of skating, typically on ice.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去散步；去走一走
words.ex: He goes for a walk after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后去散步。
words.en: To go for a walk means to leave your home or workplace in order to walk somewhere, usually for pleasure or exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；爱好；从事；赞成
words.ex: He goes in for football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都参加足球。
words.en: To participate in or be involved with something; to have a liking for something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 继续做某事（指持续进行某一动作）
words.ex: He goes on doing his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后继续做作业。
words.en: To continue an activity or task that one has already started.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 继续做某事；接着进行
words.ex: He will go on with his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后会继续做作业。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.ex: He goes on talking even when no one listens.
words.ex_cn: 即使没人听，他还是继续说。
words.en: To continue an activity or process, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.ex: They go out to watch a movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末外出看电影。
words.en: To leave a place, especially one's home, for a short time, usually for a specific purpose such as entertainment or socializing.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.ex: You had better finish your homework before going out.
words.ex_cn: 你最好在出门前完成你的作业。
words.en: used to tell someone what you think they should do

words.tr: had better do 表示“最好做某事”，用于建议或警告，带有轻微的紧迫感或后果暗示
words.ex: You had better do your homework now.
words.ex_cn: 你最好现在做作业。
words.en: Used to give advice or to tell someone what you think they should do.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 挂断；拖延；把...挂起来
words.ex: He hung up the phone after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵后，他挂断了电话。
words.en: To end a telephone conversation by breaking the connection; to suspend something from above so that it is supported only from above.

words.ex: He has a cold and stays at home.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，待在家里。
words.en: To suffer from a minor illness that makes you sneeze and cough and gives you a sore throat.

words.ex: They have a good time at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园玩得很开心。
words.en: to enjoy oneself; to spend time in a pleasant way

words.ex: I have classes every Monday and Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一和周三都有课。
words.en: To attend or be engaged in a session of instruction in a particular subject.

words.ex: I haven't heard from my friend for a week.
words.ex_cn: 我一周没有收到我朋友的消息了。
words.en: to receive communication from someone

words.ex: I have never heard of that song before.
words.ex_cn: 我以前从未听说过那首歌。
words.en: To become aware of something through hearing about it from someone else.

words.tr: phrase. v. 自取所需；随便享用（食物或饮料）
words.ex: Please help yourself to some cookies on the table.
words.ex_cn: 请随意吃一些桌上的饼干。
words.en: To take something for oneself without asking for permission, often used when offering something to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 在某方面帮助某人
words.ex: I help my brother with his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我帮我的弟弟做数学作业。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.ex: Hundreds of students came to the event.
words.ex_cn: 有数百名学生参加了这个活动。
words.en: Used to emphasize a large but indefinite number of things or people.

words.ex: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则我们会错过公交车。
words.en: If you tell someone to hurry up, you are telling them to do something more quickly than they were doing it.

words.ex: He is in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a hurry, you are doing something quickly because you do not have much time.

words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.ex: He has ten apples in all.
words.ex_cn: 他一共有十个苹果。
words.en: You use in all to emphasize that something is the total amount or number involved.

words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.ex: He is in need of help with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If someone or something is in need of something, they need it.

chapters.name: 第三部分 常见短语300 第29回合

words.tr: phrase. 按次序的；合乎程序的；井然有序
words.ex: Please line up in order.
words.ex_cn: 请按次序排队。
words.en: In the correct sequence or arrangement; appropriate or required by the circumstances.

words.ex: He studies hard in order that he can pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，以便能通过考试。
words.en: used to introduce a clause indicating the purpose of an action or event.

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.ex: He sings in public every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都在公共场合唱歌。
words.en: In a way that can be seen or heard by other people; openly.

words.ex: He looked at me in surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地看着我。
words.en: In a manner that shows you are surprised or startled by something.

words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.ex: He arrived in time for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶上了公交车。
words.en: If you say that something will happen in time or given time, you mean that it will happen eventually, after a lot of time has passed.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.ex: Can you join in the game?
words.ex_cn: 你能加入这个游戏吗？
words.en: If you join in an activity, you take part in it or become involved in it.

words.ex: He called me just now.
words.ex_cn: 他刚才给我打了电话。
words.en: A very short time ago.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做某事；持续不断地做某事
words.ex: He keeps doing his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都继续做作业。
words.en: to continue an action or state without stopping

words.ex: I keep in touch with my friend by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.ex: Keep off the grass.
words.ex_cn: 别踩草坪。
words.en: To avoid touching, stepping on, or coming into contact with something; to prevent someone or something from coming near or touching something.

words.ex: He keeps on walking even when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 即使累了，他还是继续走。
words.en: If you keep on doing something, you continue to do it and do not stop.

words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To continue to do something; to maintain something at a high level; to stay level or equal with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 打， 捶， 敲; 挝
words.ex: He knock at the door every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.tr: phrase. 撞到某人；偶然遇见某人
words.ex: He knocked into the boy while running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时撞到了那个男孩。
words.en: To accidentally hit someone with your body while moving.

words.ex: They laugh at his funny hat.
words.ex_cn: 他们因他的滑稽帽子而发笑。
words.en: To laugh at someone or something means to mock or ridicule them, often in a way that is not kind.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: We should learn from our mistakes and not repeat them.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该从错误中学习，不再重蹈覆辙。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.ex: Can you lend me your pen?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的笔借给我吗？
words.en: If you lend something you own to someone else, you allow them to have it or use it for a period of time, after which they must return it to you.

words.ex: Please let in the cat when it starts to rain.
words.ex_cn: 当下雨时，请让猫进来。
words.en: To allow someone or something to enter a place.

words.tr: phrase. 继续生存； 以...为主食, 靠...生活
words.ex: The old man lives on small donations from neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人靠邻居们的小额捐款继续生存。
words.en: To continue to exist or be remembered; to have a particular type of food or income as one's main source of sustenance.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.ex: He looks around the room to find his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他环顾房间找他的钥匙。
words.en: To direct one's gaze in various directions; to explore or examine a place or situation.

words.ex: Some people look down upon others who have less money.
words.ex_cn: 有些人瞧不起那些钱少的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.ex: Look out the window to see the birds.
words.ex_cn: 往窗外看，看看那些鸟。
words.en: To be vigilant or cautious.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.ex: There are lots of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: He made a face when he tasted the sour lemon.
words.ex_cn: 他尝到酸柠檬时皱起了脸。
words.en: To make a facial expression, often to show emotion or amusement.

words.ex: He wants to make friends with the new student.
words.ex_cn: 他想和新同学交朋友。
words.en: To become friendly with someone, or to start a friendship with them.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.ex: He made up his mind to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他下定决心戒烟。
words.en: To decide something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 成百万的；许许多多的
words.ex: Millions of people watch the game every year.
words.ex_cn: 每年有数百万人观看这场比赛。
words.en: used to emphasize a very large number of things or people.

words.ex: He is more or less ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他差不多准备好考试了。
words.en: To a certain extent; approximately.

words.tr: phrase. 既不……也不……；两者都不
words.ex: Neither Tom nor Anna likes coffee.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和安娜都不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified to indicate that they are each untrue or do not happen.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.ex: He does not play soccer any more.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: Used to indicate that a situation or action has changed and no longer exists or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 一点也不； 不必客气
words.ex: I don't like spicy food, not at all.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢辣的食物，一点也不。
words.en: Used as a polite response to thanks or to express that something is not a problem or does not matter.

words.ex: Not only does he play soccer, but he also runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅踢足球，而且还每天跑步。
words.en: Used to emphasize that in addition to the first thing mentioned, the second thing is also true and often even more significant.

words.tr: phrase. 不像…那样；没有…那么（用于比较，表示前者在程度上不如后者）
words.ex: This book is not so interesting as that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书不如那本有趣。
words.en: used to say that someone or something does not have as much of a particular quality as someone or something else

words.ex: He did not go to bed till his mother came home.
words.ex_cn: 他直到妈妈回家才去睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something does not happen before a certain time or event.

words.ex: He did not go to bed until 12 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 他直到12点才睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something does not happen before a certain point in time or event.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents now and then.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 当然，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 值班的；当值的；值勤的；在上班
words.ex: The nurse is on duty tonight.
